title: CYBRIK Investigation Evidence Bundle Contract v2
description: The authoritative response schema for security investigations in CYBRIK Suite (Pillars 3, 4, & 10). Represents the complete Investigation Graph and Evidence Bundle comprising nodes (entities, alerts, IOCs, artifacts, claims), directed edges (causal, correlation, attribution, derivation), citations with cryptographic excerpts, evaluated hypotheses, grounded evidence, policy-governed decisions/action proposals, and sub-component integrity digests for deterministic structural replay. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v2.0.0; Pillar 3 & 4 contract).

bundle_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this specific immutable investigation bundle.

investigation_id.description: Parent cybrik.investigation.v1.investigation_id. Required — every bundle is strictly investigation-scoped (ADR-0006 E6).

tenant_id.description: Authoritative tenant identifier governing this investigation.

status.description: Snapshot of the parent investigation lifecycle status at bundle generation time (open, in_progress, completed, abstained, closed).

claims.description: Digest-bound claims or references asserted by the investigation agents. MUST be non-empty — an investigation with no grounded findings still surfaces at least one 'abstained' claim (Roadmap Week 2), never an empty silent bundle.

nodes.description: Graph nodes representing entities, IOCs, assets, alerts, claims, artifacts, actors, techniques, and vulnerabilities within the investigation knowledge graph.

edges.description: Directed relational edges between graph nodes expressing causal links, correlations, derivations, support/refutation relations, and MITRE ATT&CK technique mappings.

citations.description: Cryptographically verifiable source citations grounding findings in raw tool outputs, telemetry logs, CTI feeds, and sandbox reports.

hypotheses.description: Investigative hypotheses formulated and evaluated by orchestrator agents, including supporting evidence, counter-evidence, and contradiction detection states.

evidence.description: Digest-bound references or structured items representing concrete evidence collected during tool executions and sensory intake.

decisions.description: Action proposals, case verdicts, mitigation recommendations, and containment decisions generated by investigation agents under strict policy constraints.

limitations.description: Explicit statement of data coverage gaps, unavailable telemetry, tool timeouts, or scope limitations (evidence-first triage over ungrounded prose).

generated_by.description: Authenticated actor (workload identity or service) that assembled the bundle. Written strictly by authenticated platform code.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the bundle was sealed.

data_marking.description: Authoritative security data marking of the bundle. MUST be >= the union of all referenced items (control-enforced non-downgrade).

digest.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest over the canonical serialization of this bundle (excluding digest itself), ensuring tamper-evident structural replay.

digests.description: Granular component digests enabling sub-graph verification and targeted differential replay.

graphNode.description: Discrete entity or conceptual node within the investigation knowledge graph.

node_id.description: Unique identifier for this node within the bundle graph (e.g. node--<uuid> or typed ID).

type.description: Canonical entity type of the graph node.

label.description: Human-readable label for UI graph visualization.

properties.description: Structured typed attributes of the node (e.g. IPv4/IPv6, SHA256, MITRE ID, hostname).

source_refs.description: References to source objects or raw telemetry grounding this node.

graphEdge.description: Directed relationship linking two graph nodes with typed causal or contextual semantics.

edge_id.description: Unique identifier for the edge within the bundle graph.

source_node_id.description: node_id of the originating graph node.

target_node_id.description: node_id of the destination graph node.

weight.description: Relative importance or relationship strength (0.0 to 1.0).

confidence.description: Confidence in the validity of this relationship (0.0 to 1.0).

citation_refs.description: Citations providing factual backing for this edge.

properties.description: Additional edge metadata (e.g. timestamps, port numbers, protocol).

citationItem.description: Verifiable reference to external evidence, tool logs, or knowledge base entries.

source_type.description: Classification of the cited data source.

source_ref.description: Pointer to specific entity or record ID within the source system.

excerpt.description: Concise, verbatim excerpt or structured snippet demonstrating the finding.

locator.description: Internal URI or owner locator (e.g. cybrik://soc/alert/123). MUST NOT be public untrusted URL.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the cited raw record content.

investigationHypothesis.description: Hypothesis tested during agent reasoning with supporting and refuting evidence.

statement.description: Formal propositional claim to be verified by investigation steps.

status.description: Current validation state of the hypothesis.

contradiction_notes.description: Explicit analysis of conflicting evidence or competing hypotheses.

investigationClaim.description: Inline claim structure representing a grounded assertion or recorded abstention.

evidenceRecord.description: Structured evidence record capturing tool execution results, logs, or artifact analysis.

investigationDecision.description: Action proposal, triage verdict, or response recommendation formulated by the investigation.
